rendered.overview: [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] leads a five-color Ally deck built around bending triggers: earthbend, waterbend, firebend, and airbend effects each draw a card off the commander and push toward transforming him for a burst of life, cards, counters, and damage. [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] alongside either [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] or [[Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury]] can chain airbend-and-recast loops into infinite creature tokens and triggers.

strategy: Ramp through early mana rocks and land tutors to reach [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] around turn 3.
Trigger waterbend, earthbend, firebend, and airbend effects each turn to draw cards off [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].
Assemble [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] with [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] to loop airbend recasts into tokens.
Transform into [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]]'s back side for a burst of life, cards, counters, and damage.
Use Shrine enchantments to chain draws and ramp while building toward the transform payoff.

keep: Keeping [[Sol Ring]] with a plan to hit land drops into turn 4 works well.
sendBack: A hand lacking any bending trigger source stalls the commander's draw engine.

tips.text: Cast [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] after [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] so its airbend fuels recast spells for tokens.
[[Toph, Hardheaded Teacher]] returns a Lesson from the graveyard that [[Gran-Gran]] discarded for value.

keyCards.job: Draws off bending; transforms for burst value.

Moderate: Losing [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] repeatedly cuts off the main card draw engine and the transform payoff entirely.

rendered.overview: This mono Red Goblin tribal deck builds a wide board and converts tokens into direct damage. Use [[Goblin War Strike]] or wide combat with haste enablers like [[Bloodlust Inciter]] to close the game.
Backfill with burn spells such as [[Lightning Bolt]] and [[Fireball]] to finish off opponents directly.

sendBack: A hand full of expensive spells with no early plays stumbles without ramp.

Use [[Goblin Bombardment]] to sacrifice extra tokens from [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] for direct damage any target.
Give a token haste with [[Goblin Chieftain]] so it can attack immediately after [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] makes it.

Let devotion Gods like [[Purphoros, God of the Forge]] and [[The Locust God]] turn tokens into damage and draws.

[[Smothering Tithe]] Treasures help cast [[Jeska's Will]] for a bigger burst off your opponent's hand.
